raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (327 rows, ingested 2026-01-18, all with amount_unit='USD_CENTS') stores amounts in cents, but silver_transactions passes amount through unchanged, so those rows are 100x too large and inflate the 2026-01-17 mean. Converting USD_CENTS amounts to dollars in silver_transactions and leaving the gold steps to recompute from it corrects the data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(CASE WHEN amount_unit = 'USD_CENTS' THEN amount / 100.0 ELSE amount END AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
